searchText: Dedaub just shared a final draft for their impact analysis on EIPs-6404 and 6466: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1p-1VvOGwI5GHkwaGMzJYDL7Affofm6rVLa6cvnmoqGI/edit cc: <@881905303011086387> Wow, that's awesome and thorough, and most importantly also independent of whatever specific format details we end up going with! Will still have to go through it in detail, but first impression is 🔥 One aspect about impact would also be, how correlated it is to impact of verkle for state trie. I think it could align conceptually to do both the state (to verkle) and other tries (to SSZ) in the same fork
